attributes.action: Recognise Polyamorous Relationships in UK Law and Protect Polyamorous People
attributes.additional_details: We call on the Government to recognise consensual polyamorous relationships in UK law, ensure that polyamorous households receive fair and appropriate treatment, and introduce explicit legal protections against discrimination based on polyamorous relationship status.
attributes.background:
We call on the UK Government to:

Legally recognise consensual polyamorous relationships.

Ensure fair treatment and recognition of polyamorous households.

Make polyamorous relationship status a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what changes you would like the Government to make to legally recognise polyamorous relationships or ensure fair treatment of polyamorous households.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
